articles.summary: SAN DIEGO [March 6, 2025] - Trestle Biotherapeutics, Inc., today announced a research collaboration with Humacyte, Inc. (Nasdaq: HUMA), a commercial-stage biotechnology platform company developing universally implantable, bioengineered human tissue at commercial scale. The post Trestle Bio Announces Research Collaboration with Humacyte first appeared on Trestle Biotherapeutics .
articles.title: Trestle Bio Announces Research Collaboration with Humacyte
